title: Close to perfect.
body:
It’s a well-made app. It works, it does exactly what it’s supposed to. But a crucial feature of quitting habits is the constant reward and praise, motivating us from going through with our commitment. 

An incredibly powerful tool to do just that would be to have friends in the app, who we would interact and track each other’s progress on a regular basis. Like Duolingo’s celebrating reaction button to when a friend’s streak reaches a round number.
